Listen to this article Share PIVOT Integrated Energy Services Limited has joined Mentor Matchup Challenge 8.0 (MMC 8.0) as Headline Sponsor, reinforcing the important role of energy in supporting business activity, enabling trade and strengthening the value chains that connect African markets. Advertisement Advertisement Themed Building Value Chains for Equitable Trade , MMC 8.0 will take place from December 4–6, 2026, at the Landmark Event Centre, Victoria Island, Lagos. The three-day event is expected to attract more than 3,000 delegates and feature over 50 speakers from across Africa and beyond. Operating in Nigeria’s downstream energy sector, PIVOT serves business and retail customers through petroleum product supply and distribution. The company ﬁrst partnered with MMC in 2024 as a Gold Sponsor and returned for the eighth edition as Headline Sponsor, building on an established relationship and a shared interest in the role of strategic partnerships and investment in strengthening businesses and connecting value chains across Africa. PIVOT’s retail presence currently includes stations in Eket, Akwa Ibom , Coal Camp in Enugu and Aﬁkpo Road in Abakaliki. With a vision to establish a nationwide retail network, the company is also set to extend its footprint to Aba and Abuja before the end of 2026, expanding access to its services across more locations in Nigeria. The company recently recorded a signiﬁcant milestone with the early redemption of its ₦8.25 billion Series 1 Tranche A Commercial Paper on October 31, 2026, two days ahead of its scheduled maturity date of November 2, 2026. The 90-day instrument marked PIVOT’s ﬁrst repayment obligation since entering Nigeria’s Commercial Paper market, demonstrating its commitment to meeting its ﬁnancial obligations. As Headline Sponsor, PIVOT brings its experience in Nigeria’s downstream energy sector to MMC 8.0, contributing to discussions on how energy supply, infrastructure and investment support business productivity and the movement of goods across value chains. The partnership also highlights the importance of investment and collaboration in strengthening businesses and expanding trade across African markets. Advertisement Commenting on the sponsorship, Ezinne Nwazulu, Managing Partner at 234Finance, organisers of MMC, said: “Energy plays a fundamental role in the competitiveness of African businesses and the strength of our value chains. From production and manufacturing to transportation and distribution, reliable energy supply and investment in the sector have implications across the wider economy. Having PIVOT Advertisement Integrated Energy Services as our Headline Sponsor strengthens the connection between this year’s theme and the role of energy in building competitive businesses and more resilient value chains. We are pleased to have their support as we convene business leaders, investors and other stakeholders to examine opportunities for growth, investment and stronger trade relationships across African markets.” A major feature of MMC 8.0 is the AfroTrade Deal Room, an investment matchmaking platform designed to connect African businesses with investors, Development Finance Institutions (DFIs) and strategic partners through structured engagements and pre-scheduled meetings. The Deal Room is targeting more than $1 billion in aggregate deal ﬂow across agribusiness, energy, manufacturing, trade and investment, and the creative economy. Advertisement Advertisement The event will also feature six panel sessions, six masterclasses, a mentorship lounge and exhibitions, providing participants with opportunities to examine developments across key sectors, gain practical business insights and explore strategic partnerships. The inaugural MMC Awards & Gala will take place on December 6, recognising individuals and organisations contributing to entrepreneurship, mentorship and business development across Africa. MMC 8.0 is organised by 234Finance, a Pan-African platform built around ﬁve pillars: Content, Community, Collaboration, Capacity Building and Capital. Through its annual Mentor Matchup Challenge, 234Finance brings together entrepreneurs, investors, business leaders and other stakeholders to support enterprise development and expand opportunities for cross-border trade and investment across the continent.
